author: IGN
description:
Romeo is a Dead Man reviewed by Will Borger on PS5, also available on Xbox Series X|S and PC.

"I don’t know if Romeo is a Dead Man always works. I don’t love how repetitive its action can be, and the story is both endearingly bonkers and hard to follow. I wish there was more depth to its combat. I wish it explained how crucial things like Bastards were sooner. Like the Fractured Universe Romeo is in, it’s a whole lot of disparate parts that don’t always add up to a coherent whole. But I’ll be damned if I can’t stop thinking about it, and I respect how it tells its story through its gameplay. Is it good? I think so. Did I enjoy the act of playing it? Sometimes. Did it stick with me? Yeah. Yeah it did. Enough that I might go back to see if anything different happens in New Game Plus. And so we reach the end of the sphere, and start again."
title: Romeo is a Dead Man Review

Based on the hit video game of the same name,  The Mortuary Assistant  opens in theaters nationwide on Friday, 2/13, and will be available to stream on Shudder 3/27. In this exclusive clip, Rebecca Owens (Willa Holland) is attacked... by one of the bodies in her morgue!
The Mortuary Assistant follows newly certified mortician Rebecca Owens (Holland), who accepts a night shift at a mortuary, embalming bodies alone after hours. As disturbing events escalate, Rebecca uncovers demonic rituals, the dark secrets of her enigmatic mentor (Sparks), and her own buried trauma—racing to survive the night before her body becomes a vessel for possession.

description:
The medical exams on The Last Night are... unconventional, to say the least. Conducted by the enigmatic WorstPink, the "Time Shocking Labyrinth" is a grueling 100-question gauntlet that forces Romeo through a choose-your-own-adventure nightmare. One wrong turn sends you back to the very beginning, turning a routine check-up into a test of pure endurance. If you're looking to bypass the trial-and-error and get straight to the rewards, we’ve mapped out every correct choice to help you survive the quiz and claim your prize.

This Romeo Is a Dead Man walkthrough provides the full solution for the WorstPink 100-question quiz, specifically designed to help players unlock the "Romeo Is a Wed Man" trophy and achievement. We cover every branch of the Time Shocking Labyrinth so you can navigate the medical exam without restarting. Whether you're playing on PC or console, use these answers to save time on your way to 100% completion in this ultra-violent science fiction epic.

#IGN
title: Romeo Is a Dead Man: WorstPink’s 100-Question Quiz Guide

We’ll show you why prioritizing the Deadgear Cannon Ball arcade machine is the key to upgrading your HP and Regenetizer capacity, and why you shouldn't skip the optional Palace Athenes dungeons.
